view: AP (frontal, L marker on image right; conventional orientation)
technical_quality: Adequate penetration, minimal rotation, apices included. Lower thorax/upper abdomen obscured by a lead shield; an external tubing/lead overlies the right hemithorax. Right heart border and right hemidiaphragm obscured by the lower-zone opacity, so cardiac size cannot be reliably assessed on this AP film.

devices.type: External tubing / lead wire overlying the chest (straight, crosses anatomical boundaries; not intravascular)
devices.location: Enters from the right axillary region, courses obliquely across the right hemithorax over the spine to the lower left paraspinal region

devices.type: Small rectangular radiopaque object, likely ECG electrode or tubing clip (external)
devices.location: Right upper lateral chest wall, approximately 3rd anterior rib level, adjacent to the external tubing

devices.type: Lead side marker 'L' with technologist initials 'DG'
devices.location: Upper right corner of image, above the patient's left shoulder
Projected over the patient's left humeral head / shoulder
Lower portion of image, covering the upper abdomen below the diaphragms

abnormalities.finding: Large homogeneous dome-shaped opacity (~14 cm transverse) with a smooth convex superior margin at about the 4th-5th anterior rib level, silhouetting the right hemidiaphragm and right heart border; the right dome sits ~7-8 cm above the left. Differential: large right basal/diaphragmatic mass vs markedly elevated right hemidiaphragm (eventration, phrenic palsy, hepatomegaly/hepatic mass) vs subpulmonic effusion
Right costophrenic angle not clearly delineated (possible small pleural effusion; uncertain)

description_zh: AP 胸部X光，右下肺野可見一大片均質、上緣呈平滑弧形凸起之緻密影，橫徑約 14 cm，遮蔽右側橫膈與右心緣（矽影徵象），右側「橫膈」高度較左側高出約 7–8 cm，鑑別包括右下胸腔／橫膈大型腫塊、明顯抬高之右側橫膈或肺下積液，建議進一步影像評估；右側肋膈角亦未清楚顯示。左肺野清晰，左側橫膈與肋膈角正常，胃泡位置正常，氣管居中。可見一條外在管線由右腋下斜跨右胸壁至下段脊椎左側，右上外側胸壁另有一小塊長方形不透光物（疑為電極或夾具），左肩處有金屬箭頭定位標記與「L DG」側別標記，下腹部覆蓋鉛板。未見胸管、引流管或其他已治療之證據。
